name: Guile of the Raptor
summary: At Hammerfall, Tor'gan sends you to Gor'mul with an orb to rouse the warrior's spirit. Its energy bears the raptor's essence and may give Gor'mul fresh purpose.

sections.title: Tor'gan's Orb
sections.body:
Tor'gan gives you an orb meant to fill Gor'mul with the raptor's essence. He hopes it will rouse the warrior's spirit and set him on a fresh course in life.

Once Gor'mul is himself again, Tor'gan plans to explain the Horde's present state. He hopes to win the help of a great warrior in its unceasing battles.

sections.title: Gor'mul's Bitterness
sections.body: Gor'mul greets your return with bitterness. He says all he wants is more of Tor'gan's pity, then mocks you with talk of brightly colored string.

sections.title: A Strange Power
sections.body: The orb draws Gor'mul's interest. He remarks on the strange power it gives off.

sections.title: The Raptor Within
sections.body: As Gor'mul takes the orb, his blood stirs and the raptor's guile slips through him. He wonders aloud if this is the shamanism Tor'gan spoke of. Then he declares himself renewed, with his strength returning.

faq.answer: At Hammerfall, Gor'mul is a despondent warrior. Tor'gan hopes to lift his spirits and set him on a new course, so the Horde can gain the aid of a great warrior.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Tor'gan's Orb?
faq.answer: Tor'gan's Orb bears energy meant to fill Gor'mul with the raptor's essence. It may rouse his spirit and give him fresh purpose.
An earlier Guile of the Raptor comes first. This step builds on what happened there.
